title: EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins
abstract: arXiv:2610.34358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task success is not a sufficient measure of safety for embodied artificial intelligence (AI), because robots may complete objectives while violating safety requirements. Existing evaluations often emphasize performance and robustness, but lack a systematic route from documented safety hazards to executable, verifiable tests. We present EAST (Embodied AI Safety Testing), a digital-twin framework that converts literature-grounded safety evidence into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing. EAST combines an expert-reviewed safety-fault taxonomy and eight executable operators with applicability and validity constraints. Its three-stage workflow generates test specifications, verifies fault realization during simulated execution, and independently assesses safety challenges, violations, task outcomes, and behavioral signatures using simulator-state evidence. translated_title: EAST：基于数字孪生系统化故障注入的具身人工智能安全测试
translated_abstract: 任务成功并不是衡量具身人工智能（AI）安全性的充分标准，因为机器人可能在违反安全要求的情况下完成目标。现有的评估通常强调性能和鲁棒性，但缺乏从已记录的安全危害到可执行、可验证测试的系统性路径。我们提出了EAST（具身人工智能安全测试），这是一个数字孪生框架，能够将基于文献的安全证据转化为涵盖感知、指令、环境、动作和时序五个方面的故障注入测试。EAST结合了经专家审查的安全故障分类法以及八个带有适用性和有效性约束的可执行操作符。其三阶段工作流程可生成测试规范，在仿真执行过程中验证故障是否真正实现，并利用仿真器状态证据独立评估安全挑战、违规行为、任务结果和行为特征。该框架保持了执行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EAST是一个基于数字孪生的具身AI安全测试框架，它通过系统化的故障注入方法，将文献中记录的安全证据转化为覆盖感知、指令、环境、动作和时序的可执行、可验证的安全测试。
en_tdlr: EAST is a digital-twin framework for embodied AI safety testing that systematically converts literature-grounded safety evidence into executable and verifiable fault-injection tests spanning perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing.
